title: pefftacular: Reading and writing PSI Extended FASTA files in Python
description: pefftacular is a pure-Python library for reading and writing PSI Extended FASTA Format (PEFF) files, a FASTA extension for proteomics annotations. It provides an eager read_peff function and a lazy PeffReader for processing files without loading every sequence into memory. The parser represents file headers, database headers, sequences, and annotations as frozen typed data classes. Supported entry annotations include simple and complex variants, UniMod and PSI-MOD modifications, processed regions, proteoforms, disulfide bonds, and header-defined custom values. The writer serializes these models to canonical PEFF text and preserves the escaping rules used in description lines. Parsing follows the PEFF 1.0 specification. Structural failures raise errors with line, context, and repair hints, while recoverable specification violations produce warnings and retain the parsed data. The package targets proteomics tools that need programmatic PEFF validation, conversion, inspection, or generation. It requires Python 3.12 or later and has no runtime dependencies.
